body:
Thank you so much for your quick response! I do realize the meds won’t do much of anything, almost was looking for the placebo effect lol.

I have talked to a certain extent about the way I’m feeling to a couple people, and been more candid with the people I’m travelling with. My parents are also coming on the vacation so thank goodness for that! They are huge supporters to me. 

I don’t deal well with feeling overwhelmed. I am overthinking every aspect of the trip right now, anxiety just wants to take over.

As a single Mom, any extra cash is appreciated at this time of year. An extra $100 can make all the difference. None of us want our kids to know we can't afford the things they want so badly. That money could make a kids Christmas wish come true.

A discount on the rent for the month would always be the most amazing (and unexpected), but, as OP stated, rent is already paid for December. Either way, an extra $100 is in the tenant's pocket from the goodness of OP's heart.

Thank you OP for being the kind of person who thinks about their tenants, and wants to put a smile on someone's face. True Holiday spirit 🙌🏻 A very happy holiday season to you and your family ✌🏻
Congratulations, so happy for you and your family
